Oliver Wyman to acquire financial services consultancy Synpulse
stories.summary: Oliver Wyman has agreed to acquire Synpulse, a financial services consultancy with 1,200 professionals. The firm describes the deal as the largest acquisition in its history, intended to strengthen its capabilities in AI-enabled business change. The transaction is expected to close in early 2027. Terms were not disclosed.

stories.title: Oliver Wyman Acquires Synpulse to Bridge Strategy and Delivery
stories.summary: Oliver Wyman has agreed to acquire Synpulse, a Zurich-founded technology and consulting firm serving banks, insurers and wealth managers, in a deal that hands the management consultancy roughly 1,200 technologists and a ready-built AI delivery arm. The transaction, announced on 12 November 2026, is expected to close in early 2027.

stories.title: KPMG executive says AI is making consulting advice obsolete
stories.summary: KPMG global head of consulting Svilena Tzekova told CNBC that artificial intelligence is undermining the firm's traditional business model. Tzekova stated that clients can now obtain advice that previously required months of work, adding that the firm's revenue source for providing such advice is now literally nonexistent.

stories.summary: Australia’s accounting sector has split in two as mid-tier and smaller practices increased revenue 9 per cent to $6.55 billion, while the big four contracted 1.6 per cent to $9 billion because of sluggish consulting demand and governance scandals. stories.summary: The economic contribution of the Global Capacity Centres (GCCs) established by global pharmaceutical majors in India could be as high as $ 182 billion, a report jointly prepared by Organisation of Pharmaceutical Producers of India (OPPI) and consultancy EY estimates. stories.title: EY and IPRS report finds music streaming growth fails to support creators
stories.summary: Indians streamed six trillion songs in 2025, according to a report by EY and the Indian Performing Right Society. While the industry generated 17,401 crore in economic value, the share of composers and lyricists able to pursue music full-time fell to 55 per cent from 60 per cent.

stories.summary: A significant majority of Indian consumers have integrated technology into their personal health management, with 90 per cent now using health applications or wearable devices. stories.title: PwC report finds 73 per cent of Indian consumers use AI for health queries
stories.summary: PwC India reports that 90 per cent of Indian consumers use health apps or wearables, compared with 80 per cent globally. Additionally, 73 per cent of respondents turn to AI tools for initial health questions, significantly higher than the global average of 51 per cent.

stories.title: Indian consumers prioritising longevity and wellness
stories.summary: A PwC India report finds consumers are increasingly taking ownership of their health through digital tools and specific food choices to reach sustainable outcomes. India music economy reaches $1.8 billion
stories.summary: Music generated an estimated $1.8 billion in economic activity in 2025, a 45 per cent increase over two years, according to an EY study. Independent artists captured 43 per cent of digital streams. Indians streamed nearly six trillion tracks last year. The industry is listening to the numbers.

stories.title: AI leaders in industrials grow revenue faster than laggards
stories.summary: Industrial companies leading in AI grew revenues more than twice as fast as laggards, according to BCG. While the firm suggests AI-first companies could lift EBIT margins by up to 5.6 percentage points, only 12 per cent of industrial firms currently possess the necessary data capabilities. Data is optional.

Kinbrook Group acquires Hilton Consulting
stories.summary: Kinbrook Group has acquired London-based Hilton Consulting, marking its third acquisition this year. The firm, led by Ben Warren, provides accountancy and advisory services to the creative industries. The group is adding to its presence in London. The creative industries now have a new accountant.

stories.title: Steer acquires maritime consultancy Mercator International
stories.summary: Steer has completed the acquisition of Kirkland-based Mercator International to expand its advisory capabilities in the ports and freight sectors. Mercator will join Steer’s North America division but will continue to operate under its existing name. The company will keep its name while changing its owner.

Steer acquires US-based maritime and ports consultancy Mercator
stories.summary: UK-based Steer has acquired Mercator, a consultancy specialising in strategic and commercial advisory for port authorities and investors. The firm has completed over 150 commercial due diligence projects since 2000. Steer is adding to its expertise in maritime infrastructure and investment advisory services.

stories.title: Finyx Group acquires Entec Si
stories.summary: Technology consultancy Finyx Group has acquired Birmingham-based Entec Si to expand its presence in local government and non-profit sectors. Entec Si has provided transformation and programme management services since 1996. The core team of 20 professionals will now operate under new ownership.

stories.title: Tanabe Consulting Group acquires Actus
stories.summary: Japanese management consultancy Tanabe Consulting Group has acquired a majority stake in New York-based Actus Consulting Group. The firm specialises in human capital services for Japanese businesses entering the United States. Actus has worked with over 1,000 companies during its 25 years in the market.

stories.title: Consulting AG joins AdEx Partners
stories.summary: Austrian firm Consulting AG has joined German IT consultancy AdEx Partners. The deal adds 50 professionals to the firm, bringing its total headcount to approximately 350 across the DACH region. Consulting AG focuses on public sector and healthcare clients. The merger is now complete.

stories.title: RSM and UHY member firms merge in Croatia
stories.summary: RSM and UHY have merged their Croatian member firms to create a full-service professional services practice. The combined firm employs 57 experts across offices in Zagreb, Split and Koprivnica. The merger unites two firms to provide audit, tax, accounting and management consulting services.

stories.title: FTI Consulting appoints regional AI lead
stories.summary: FTI Consulting has hired Farid Zahran to lead its AI and digital transformation services in the Middle East. Zahran brings 15 years of consulting experience, including previous roles at Kearney, Strategy& and Accenture. He will advise leadership teams on enterprise data and digital agendas.

NITI Aayog identifies four manufacturing sectors
stories.summary: NITI Aayog has identified chemicals, textiles, telecom equipment, and solar PV manufacturing as high-potential sectors to drive India's manufacturing growth. The report provides a data-driven assessment of market potential, infrastructure, and technology readiness. The agency aims to identify sectors where targeted interventions can strengthen global value chains.

stories.title: Modi’s Manufacturing Mission Is Only Half Done - Bloomberg.com
Report outlines roadmap for Indian shipbuilding
stories.summary: A FICCI-EY report suggests that India's shipbuilding potential requires a coordinated approach to vessel demand, financing, and supply chains. The study benchmarks India against established shipbuilding economies to highlight the necessity of dependable order pipelines. Scaling up requires more than just building additional yard capacity.

stories.title: Manufacturing sector marks 80th Independence Day
stories.summary: India is celebrating its 80th Independence Day with a focus on manufacturing as a pillar of self-reliance. Government initiatives including the PLI scheme, PM GatiShakti, and the National Logistics Policy are credited with reshaping industries. Defence, pharmaceuticals, and heavy machinery are now produced to world-class standards.

stories.title: Auto PLI investments exceed target, but incremental sales reach only 23% of projection: NITI Aayog report - ET Auto
Ficci proposes manufacturing development finance
stories.summary: Ficci has urged the government to establish a dedicated development finance framework for manufacturing. The industry body estimates a ₹100 trillion credit need over the next decade to raise the sector's GDP contribution to 25 per cent. It also proposed a ₹12,000 crore PLI for battery components.

stories.title: Solar PLI scheme attracts ₹64,873 crore
stories.summary: NITI Aayog reports that the PLI scheme for solar modules attracted ₹64,873 crore in investments by March 2026. The initiative, backed by a ₹24,000 crore government outlay, contributed 24 GW to India's total solar manufacturing capacity. The country's module capacity now stands at nearly 116 GW.

stories.title: India's music industry records six trillion streams
stories.summary: India's music industry generated nearly six trillion streams in 2025, creating an estimated INR17,401 crore of gross economic value. An EY report notes that digital platforms and affordable connectivity have made the country a major music-consuming market. Scale is not the only metric for economic strength.

Teneo hires energy consultant Mike Granowski
stories.summary: Teneo has appointed Mike Granowski as a senior managing director on its energy and infrastructure team. Granowski joins from Roland Berger, where he led the North American energy and utilities platform. He will advise utilities and investors on strategic matters across the nuclear and power sectors.

stories.title: McDonald’s Hires Ex-McKinsey Partner in Push to Revive US Sales - Bloomberg.com
McDonald's hires strategy lead from McKinsey
stories.summary: McDonald's has appointed former McKinsey partner Hannah Yankelevich to lead its U.S. strategic insights and prioritization team starting December 1. Yankelevich spent 11 years at McKinsey and previously worked at Google. She replaces Mike Shapiro, who held various positions at the company over eight years.

stories.title: McKinsey veteran joins QuantumBlack AI
stories.summary: Brian Elliott has joined QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey, to co-lead EcliptOS. The platform is described as a modular operating system designed to integrate AI throughout organizations to improve business outcomes. Elliott brings over 20 years of experience from McKinsey, including leadership roles in pricing and revenue management.

stories.title: Deepak Rajawat Appointed Chief Executive Officer at Air India Express - https://hrtoday.in/
Air India Express names new CEO
stories.summary: Air India Express has appointed CFO Deepak Rajawat as CEO, effective December 1. The airline reported operating revenue of ₹19,088 crore in FY26, while its net loss widened to ₹6,767 crore. The company has been without a permanent CEO since March. Growth is currently outpacing profitability.

stories.title: Air India Express promotes CFO to CEO
stories.summary: Air India Express has promoted Deepak Rajawat to the role of Chief Executive Officer. Rajawat previously served as the airline's CFO since December 2024. He will now oversee strategic planning and the airline's integration into the broader Air India group. He brings two decades of aviation experience.

stories.title: Primus Partners adds four to leadership team
stories.summary: Primus Partners has appointed four senior leaders to support its institutional growth. New hires include a COO, a CHRO, an executive director for technology, and a public policy advisor. The firm aims to strengthen its capabilities in organizational transformation and strategic advisory services.
